## Native chat is ready

This response is a **local demonstration**, with no AI request. Choose a provider in **Settings → Providers** to use a real model.

### What you can try

- **Bold**, *italic* and `inline code`.
- Scrolling while text streams, selection and copying.
- Attachments, stopping and resuming a conversation.

```cpp
#include <cymcp/chat_ui.hpp>

cymcp::ChatController chat;
cymcp::ChatPanel panel(chat);
// In the render loop:
panel.draw();
```

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| CyUI | Native UI and Markdown |
| CyMCPSDK | Providers, sessions and streaming |

> The same panel can be embedded in another application.

[Project documentation](https://github.com/MrMybal/CyMCPSDK)
